hypothesis: A synthetic prequential bank can test linked fills, cash/inventory reconciliation, cost calibration, temporal isolation, stress and independent arithmetic replay. It cannot supply real fills, real prospective returns or external review.
outside_episode: NO_NEW_ENTRIES; positions expected to close; unresolved inventory is carried and reported, never silently liquidated; weekly overhead includes all seven elapsed days
candidate: Existing frozen frontier shadow engine, default Settings except synthetic-only calibrated slippage assumptions; at most one new lot per asset; no parameter search
features: Two causal context values per asset: previous 72h log return and volatility of previous eight completed windows; no hidden regime or current future path passed to core
refit: Only completed earlier windows; maximum 40 original cases; labels received strictly before current fit; query at fixed weekly boundary
execution: Synthetic marketable limits for purchases, market sells, explicit ACK/reject/partial/cancel/late reports; native units; one fixed fee per filled order; no sales-funded speculative buys
calibration: 160 synthetic fills per calibration seed, all before evaluation; separate asset/side q50/q95 adverse residual slippage and empirical holdout diagnostics; not observed broker calibration
statistics: Net account wealth, cash and open inventory, log growth, drawdown, fees, shortfall, fill ratios, deadline failures. Paired CORE-CASH terminal log differences across four independent seeds, descriptive mean/range only; no inference from four seeds or multiplicity correction claim
review: Hash-verified packet and separate Decimal event replay implementation from the same author; external reviewer status remains NOT_REVIEWED
budget: 96 market windows, 288 CORE decisions, 36 market/stress/seed combinations, 108 continuous strategy accounts; no rerun to choose favorable seeds
engineering_failure_policy: Preserve failed run incident and register corrections; no silent success relabeling or tuning after financial results
